title: Too many beasts (FCP 2026)
synopsis:
In the French countryside, wild boars ravaging crops spark an open war between farmers and members of a hunting club. Brun, a bankrupt farmer, struggles to keep his farm afloat. When the club’s president pushes him to his limits, Brun shoots him and disappears. A year later, Fulda, a volatile police officer, leads the investigation. Still struggling after a recent breakup, and as wild boars proliferate across the region, he is pushed to the brink of sanity.

 

The film will be introduced by the "Directors' Fortnight's Artistic Director Julien Rejl on 28 NOVEMBER at PREMIERE ELEMENTS.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk:
在法國鄉郊，野豬肆虐莊稼，引發農民與狩獵俱樂部成員之間公然衝突。Brun是個破產農夫，辛辛苦苦經營著他的農場，而當俱樂部主席把他逼得他退無可退時，Brun突然向對方開槍並失去蹤影。一年後，情緒不穩的警員Fulda接手調查，然而他剛分手不久，仍未恢復過來，適逢野豬在區內不斷繁殖，使他逐漸被逼到精神崩潰的邊緣。

 

11月28日PREMIERE ELEMENTS 場次放映將由「導演雙週」藝術總監Julien Rejl  作開場介紹。

cast: Alexis Manenti, Ella Rumpf, Vincent Dedienne, Jean-Louis Coulloc’h
